head: db11b3dd8c9f824cf0e6c40bc7ef5511072872e6
scope: Native Account SSO test fixture bound to the disposable erpx_test_* Control/Holding databases, plus native product-origin audiences and a test-only native Argon2id password hash route.

fixture.wiring: tests/support/runtime-env.ts starts the lazy loopback proxy only when ERPX_NATIVE_ACCOUNT_TEST_PROXY=1; scripts/testing/test.ts sets that flag for legal.* and identity_access.product-sso.integration.
fixture.profile: private_development_api::Profile::Test accepts only erpx_test_<10 hex>_(control|h00x)(_read)?_db with erpx_test_admin on 127.0.0.1:5432.
fixture.bindings: The fixture seeds holding_bindings for the suite's exact slots; the native registry verifies the same active rows.
fixture.password: POST /api/v1/test/account-password-hash (Profile::Test only) hashes with the native Argon2id parameters; the route is absent from development/production profiles.
fixture.productOrigins: AccountPolicy now carries product origins; ConfiguredHoldingRegistry maps a product audience to the same exact Holding entry; /sso/start and /sso/callback accept configured product hosts.

legal_integration.before: 3 passed / 49 failed (shared 3199 native Account API bound to the clone Control database).
legal_integration.passing: Native credential sign-in, SSO start/authorize/callback on the product host, the portal child session and all portal comment concurrency cases, Legal writer transactions, replay/stale/authority/audit/outbox cases.
remaining_failures: legal.test.ts invitation enrollment: the Legal enroll route still calls the TypeScript createAuth sign-up, which writes a Better Auth scrypt credential without issuer=local:credential. The native Account sign-in correctly rejects that credential (401), so the unverified continuation redirects to login (303) instead of the expected 403.

no_regression.support.package-surfaces.integration: 22/22 pass after rebuilding the Field held-provider example with the updated AccountPolicy constructors.
no_regression.identity_access cargo: erpx-server-identity-access: account_auth 8/8, session/work-context suites green; one unrelated key-migration backfill assertion remains (2 vs 1) in account_group_recovery_postgres.

not_certified.reason: One Legal integration case remains: Legal portal enrollment must create the account through the native Account credential/invitation service (Argon2id + local:credential issuer) instead of the TypeScript Better Auth sign-up. Secondary TypeScript Legal views also keep http/ssr partial. Legal is not owner 5/41.

notes: No production, staging, deploy, release, schema deletion or destructive cleanup was performed.
The test profile and password-hash route are unreachable from the development and production parsers.

product_audience.change: Configured product origins now issue their product key as the SSO audience (for example legal-portal). SsoPolicy.origin resolves both Holding and product origins; ConfiguredHoldingRegistry maps the product audience to the exact configured Holding binding.
product_audience.result: The nine portal child-session audience/concurrency failures are resolved. legal.legal.integration is 51 passed / 1 failed.

next: Migrate the Legal enroll route to the native Account credential/invitation service, then rerun legal.legal.integration to 52/52 and migrate the secondary TS views before certifying Legal.
